== Biography ==
David Crocket Glasgow, son of William Glasgow and Lovecia Patterson, was born on 8 Sep. 1840 at Wythe County, Virginia, USA.<ref name="IADeath">[http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?viewrecord=1&r=an&db=FS1IADeathsandBurials&indiv=try&h=250913 David C. Glasgow] Ancestry.com. Iowa, Deaths and Burials, 1850-1990 [database on-line]. Provo, UT, USA: Ancestry.com Operations, Inc, 2014.</ref>  He appeared on the census of 26 July 1850 in the home of his parents at Wythe County, Virginia.<ref name="1850 US Census">Year: 1850; Census Place: District 68, Wythe, Virginia; Roll: M432_982; Page: 249A; Image: 94 [http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?db=1850usfedcenancestry&indiv=try&h=15647165 1850 US Census. William Glasgow]</ref>  He appeared on the census of 14 June 1860 in the home of his parents at Wythe County, Virginia.  His grandmother was living with them.<ref name="1860 US CensusWG">Year: 1860; Census Place: District 68, Wythe, Virginia; Roll: M653_1385; Page: 770; Image: 127; Family History Library Film: 805385 [http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?db=1860usfedcenancestry&indiv=try&h=33881437 1860 US Census 	William P Glasgoe]</ref>

He married Calista Angeline Wilcox,<ref>[http://search.ancestry.com/cgi-bin/sse.dll?indiv=1&db=IAMarriageRec&h=1053936527&tid=&pid=&usePUB=true&rhSource=60283 David C. Glassgow] Ancestry.com. Iowa, Marriage Records, 1880-1937 [database on-line]. Provo, UT, USA: Ancestry.com Operations, Inc., 2014.</ref> daughter of Nathaniel and Hannah A. (Gardner) Wilcox.

David died on 9 Sep. 1918 at Maxwell Indian Creek Township, Story County, Iowa and was buried at Plot: Sec - 2, Row - 1, Lot - 10, [[:Category: Woodland Cemetery, Iowa Center, Iowa|Woodland Cemetery]], Iowa Center, Story County, Iowa.<ref name="IADeath"/>  His [http://www.findagrave.com/cgi-bin/fg.cgi?page=gr&GRid=22900847 memorial] has biographical material and links to those of family members.<ref>[http://www.findagrave.com/cgi-bin/fg.cgi?page=gr&GRid=22900847 Find A Grave Memorial# 22900847 David Crocket Glasgow]</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-559]] is assessed at 95% (proved). David Crocket’s held death-index-associated biography expressly identifies William Glasgow and Lovecia Patterson, and the 1850/1860 transcribed households repeatedly place David with William and Louisa. Those combined sources strongly identify the father even though the early census ages and 1850 William age vary.

Held citation and associated historical narrative address this selected father-child identity; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Read David’s 1918 Iowa death record’s literal parent names.
